requirements.text: Implement real-time transaction notifications for purchases and account activities.
Introduce biometric authentication for secure and convenient logins.
Create an intuitive in-app lending and credit application process with instant eligibility checks.
Ensure compliance with PSD2 by implementing strong customer authentication and secure third-party access.
Address GDPR requirements by focusing on data protection, user consent, and rights to access or erase personal data.
Provide notifications for budget limits and potential fraud alerts.
Implement a guided step-by-step application process for lending and credit options.
Allow customers to upload documentation directly through the app for lending applications.
Ensure funds can be transferred directly to customers' accounts almost instantly if lending applications are approved.
Implement data protection by design and default in the app development process.
Ensure all customer financial data is stored and processed within the European Economic Area (EEA).
